description: Distinct German words (dictionary forms) in the 310 questions + all options, built by scripts/build_vocabulary.py (spaCy de_core_news_md 3.8.0; word types from data/vocabulary_en.json). Names/places and abbreviations are not vocabulary. 'core' = the word appears in a question or a correct answer. Automatic lemmatization: counts are approximate (about +-5%). The key of a word is the key of its most frequent row in data/vocabulary_raw.json.
